futures_champion#fc_secondary_field_rule.detail: Verified online (NCAA announcement 1 Oct 2026 via search; ncaa.com/ncaa.org fetch blocked): 2027 NIT = 24 teams; 12 exempt bids = highest-ranked eligible team of each top-10 KenPom conference plus an extra ACC and SEC bid (all host); automatic bids to non-NCAA regular-season champions with average metric rank <=125; campus sites until the final. Patch input_patches/CBB_a.json rewrites cbb.secondary_postseason_field_model measurement/rationale/raw_data/free_sources with this rule table, KenPom conference ratings and the multi-metric average rank (NET, KenPom, BPI, KPI, SOR, Torvik, WAB, metric list single-sourced) and a 2026 Crown rule (top two non-NCAA teams of Big Ten/Big 12/Big East plus two wild cards, 8 teams) as the last published rule. No 2027 Crown allocation had been announced by Nov 2026; the record's fc_secondary_field_rules now names only that and the official metric list.

futures_seed_other#so_field_size.detail: Verified (NCAA, 7 May 2026, multiple outlets): 2027 field 76 = 32 automatic + 44 at-large; 12 Opening Round games (12 lowest at-large, 12 lowest automatic qualifiers), First Four name dropped; sampled KXMARMADROUND rules say Round of 76 = qualifying for the field. Record futures_seed_other (CBB_a.json) now carries cbb.tournament_field_format in new_inputs (identical catalog definition, role primary), stages s3/s5, settlement_contract coverage, a contract edge case and a threshold interaction with cbb.committee_ordinal_seed_model. Patches rewrite cbb.tournament_field_format rationale/measurement with the verified structure and replace 68-team/First Four assumptions in cbb.bracket_sim, cbb.auto_bid_structure, cbb.bracket_seed_statistic_sim, cbb.player_game_exposure_tournament, cbb.milestone_union_aggregation and cbb.wcbb_title_probability (women's field is also 76). No catalog text actually said '36 at-large'.
